claim.title: Solar Classroom DAO Nairobi delivery review
claim.question: Did Solar Classroom DAO run six community workshops and deliver roughly 180 refurbished devices across two schools in Nairobi during February 2026?
claim.context: The evaluation team needs a human-backed legitimacy signal before final scoring and wants any disagreement surfaced rather than buried.

recommendation.note: The claim is supported by a Self-verified witness quorum with usable evidence coverage.

summary: The witness pool currently leans support with a consensus ratio of 0.75.
nextQuestions: Resolve divergence on School B: delivered, late.

acceptedWitnesses.statement: I attended four of the six workshops directly and saw the final delivery batch arrive. My estimate is roughly 176 devices across both schools.
The project definitely ran six workshops. Our logistics sheet recorded 180 devices earmarked for the two schools, though some were delivered in separate batches.
The workshops happened, but the second school received the last equipment later than the public post suggested. I would put the count closer to 160 at the time of the main announcement.
I attended the final community showcase and saw multiple device handoffs. I cannot verify the exact count, but the program clearly happened and both schools were involved.
